biography:
After the realization set in that I will not be making it as an NBA player (I was never close), I spent many nights and days seeking a new dream job but alas that too has slipped my grasp. In my desperation when I thought all hope was gone, I find myself in an industry and a role that is perfect for my personality and disposition. I essentially am in a role that everybody wants to know but nobody wants to be in, given the amount of personal time and effort that goes into being a go to person. 

Luckily enough, I am blessed with great organizational skills, flexibility and genuine love to be someone's super hero. Nothing else can grow an organization like the way trust, consistency and dependability can, and I certainly am proud of being so dedicated to all 3. I find myself in a company that has great eye and appreciation for people with talent and these characteristics; which has made my immersion very easy. 

In my spare time, I enjoy a lot of things but bottom line I am just a dad and husband at the end of the day. Boring as it may sound, but it's true. I enjoy boring. I enjoy being with my baby girl. I enjoy spending time with my wife. They are the non-negotiables in my life and my driving force. 

My 3 teachable points of view are 1) Don't Settle - be better, continue to learn, stretch yourself, improve, be relevant! 2) Network - be kind to everyone you meet, you need all the support network you can have to be successful. 3) Know your Why - in order to be truly happy at what you're doing, focus on your WHY and not the HOW ...
